capabilities: Render chatgpt-ui JSON blocks as widgets (maps, choice chips, math, source lists)
Draw JSX-like markup as layouts, charts, code blocks, icons and inline cite chips
Convert ChatGPT data exports into one Markdown note per conversation
Save user answers from choice chips back into the code block
Fetch images for AsyncImage queries from Openverse and Wikimedia Commons
disambiguation: It only draws markup already saved from a ChatGPT data export; it does not generate UIs, run ChatGPT, or execute HTML apps or templated drawings.
extras: Installed manually by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugins folder. Image fetching is off by default; network requests go only to OpenStreetMap and Openverse when triggered, with no telemetry, accounts or keys. Save answers rewrites the code block, which a re-run importer would overwrite.
problem: Obsidian shows ChatGPT conversation exports as raw code blocks and inline markup, hiding the widgets, layouts and sources the answers originally displayed.

relations.evidence: the place names and addresses of that block go to OpenStreetMap Nominatim
the query of each image is sent to Openverse (api.openverse.org)
then Wikimedia Commons if nothing is found

summary: Renders ChatGPT answer UI — maps, choice questions, stat cards, charts and source chips — inside Obsidian from notes holding a ChatGPT export's markup.
